On price-level metrics all ten arms coincide (MAPE 3.542-3.566%, R2 0.7786-0.7815), so the metrics the literature reports cannot rank these models. Neural baselines are positive only on SHANGHAI (+3.2 to +3.7%) and negative on GUANGZHOU (-4.9 to -8.2%). All arms under-cover nominal 80% (0.74-0.76) and 95% (0.88-0.92).

current_evidence: seven candidate directions are negative or zero: neural transport, exponential tilt, RBF correction, cross-market information, inner-selected hyperparameters, split objectives, multi-horizon coherence, and learned zero inflation. The only CI-supported positive is the reference construction (maturity-masked zero-inflated forest + gamma uniform reservoir + rule zero atom) at +0.174% MQS / +0.155% CRPS vs standard QRF, consistent in sign across 5 markets but significant only in SHANGHAI. Every 1-2% gain found on test reproduces only with look-ahead information and reverses sign when made causal.
